PRIVATE CAREGIVER RECORD

Track medication handoffs between family caregivers.

For adult children and home caregivers who need a clear record when another caregiver takes over.

Try it with sample data
Open a filled sample handoff in one click.
Add your first medication
Medication records stay in this browser.
The board works offline after your first visit.
Printing, QR handoffs, and exports are free.

HOW IT WORKS

Create a medication handoff in three steps
Add the current medication list.
Enter each medication, amount, and scheduled time.
Mark each dose.
Choose Taken, Held, or Unknown and add a note.
Print, share, or back up the handoff.
Print for the next caregiver, show the QR code in person, or save a backup for yourself.

HANDOFF TOOLS

Print, share, or back up the handoff

Print the handoff, show its QR code to another caregiver, or save your own backup.

Print handoff

Export backup
Import backup

A QR handoff contains the selected date, current medication list, and dose states. Anyone who scans it can read it, so share it only with someone you trust.
